title: Weeks 2-3: Platform architecture and APIs
text: Course topic (lectures Wk02-Wk03): platform architecture, REST API design, HTTP methods and status codes, API contracts and versioning, MCP servers that expose tools to AI agents.
keywords: สถาปัตยกรรม

title: Week 4: Platform data
text: Course topic (lecture Wk04): platform data and databases, SQL, Cloudflare D1, Supabase, PostgreSQL, schema design, migrations, validating data before it is written.

title: Weeks 5-6: Security, extensibility and integration
text: Course topic (lectures Wk05-Wk06): authentication, OAuth, JWT, API keys, secrets, webhooks, events, plugins and integrating external services.
keywords: ความปลอดภัย

title: Weeks 8-9: AI-native capability design and evaluation
text: Course topic (lectures Wk08-Wk09): AI decision capabilities, decision models such as Jev and Laya, output validation, confidence thresholds, fallback design, grounding context, evaluation sets, accuracy and latency.

title: Assignment briefs (A6, A7)
text: Assignment requirements: A6 builds an AI decision capability with test cases, fallback and a report A6_StudentID.pdf. A7 evaluates it with 10 eval cases, baseline, one improvement, report A7_StudentID.pdf, eval-cases.json and a disclosure of AI assistance. Questions about tasks, files, format or rubric are assignment questions.

title: Grades, extensions and attendance policy
text: Policy: grades, score checks, deadline extensions, late submission, sickness, attendance and enrolment are decided only by the instructor (Aj. Vittayasak). The assistant must escalate these to the instructor, even when an assignment is mentioned.

title: Academic integrity
text: Policy: the assistant explains course material but must not write, solve or complete a student's graded work (reports, code, labs). Requests to do the work for the student are out of scope and must be declined.

title: Assistant scope
text: Policy: the Learning Assistant only handles questions about course 1305308 Platform Development: its lectures, assignments and course administration. Anything else (food, travel, entertainment, other courses, personal advice) is out of scope.
